components.name: Primary Docs Action
components.description: Primary call to start reading or install the library.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #f54780; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: #c72e62; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f9b0cb; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Docs Action
components.description: Secondary navigation action for explanatory pages.
components.css: .ds-secondary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #3d1527; color: #f9b0cb; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid #6e1f3d; transition: color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-secondary-action:hover { color: #ffe7ee; border-color: #f54780; } .ds-secondary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f9b0cb; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Docs Card
components.description: Documentation feature grouping for CRDT types or package concepts.
components.html:
Counters

Grow-only and positive-negative counters for distributed counting with automatic convergence.
components.css: .ds-docs-card { max-width: 22rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #6e1f3d; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #2a0818; color: #ffe7ee; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; } .ds-docs-card h3 { margin: 0 0 0.45rem; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-docs-card p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; color: #f5a8c0; }

components.name: Caution Aside
components.description: Trust-building caution block for pre-1.0 status or API stability notes.
components.html:
Pre-1.0 Software

The API is unstable, features may be removed in minor releases, and quality should not be considered production-ready.
components.css: .ds-caution { max-width: 40rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #a8345e; background: #3d1527; color: #ffe7ee; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; } .ds-caution strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-caution p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; color: #f9b0cb; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar-style navigation item for docs orientation.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 0.45rem; color: #ffe7ee; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: #3d1527; color: #f9b0cb; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f54780; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: lattice should feel like rigorous proofs made readable: a precise technical notebook where every visual choice helps developers trust the convergence model, choose the right CRDT, and move into code. The system is documentation-first, but it still needs a memorable public face: saturated magenta and plum tones give the library identity without becoming generic devtool gloss.
keyCharacteristics: Documentation density with a clear public identity.
Magenta/plum color as structure, not decoration.
High-contrast reading surfaces for long-form technical content.
Honest pre-1.0 caution presented as trust-building context.

rules.name: The One Proof Color Rule
rules.body: Magenta is the proof mark: it should identify actions, links, and selected state. Do not scatter it as decoration.

rules.name: The No Gradient Hero Rule
rules.body: Gradient text and gradient hero treatments are prohibited. The brand is carried by type, color discipline, and explanatory artifacts.

rules.name: The Readable Math Rule
rules.body: If a typography choice makes a proof, code example, package table, or warning harder to read, it is wrong no matter how distinctive it looks.

rules.name: The Flat Notebook Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are pages, not floating panes. Use borders, spacing, and tone before shadow.

dos: Do use Convergence Magenta for meaningful action, active, and link states.
Do keep Bricolage Grotesque focused on headings and identity moments.
Do use Atkinson Hyperlegible for long-form docs, package explanations, and guides.
Do show correctness with code, examples, package boundaries, and explanatory diagrams.
Do preserve high contrast for docs and code in both light and dark themes.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS/devtool landing-page clichés: gradient heroes, metric blocks, identical icon-card grids as the primary storytelling device, or vague "scale your workflow" copy.
Don't turn CRDT rigor into a dense academic archive.
Don't use monospace as decorative shorthand for "technical"; reserve code faces for code.
Don't add glassmorphism, oversized glow, or ambient shadows as a default surface treatment.
